  "textEditContent": "# API Reference Documentation\n\n## cTasks Class\n\nThe main thread pool class responsible for managing threads and task queues.\n\n### Properties\n\n#### ThreadCount\n- **Type**: Long\n- **Description**: Gets the current number of threads in the thread pool\n- **Access Level**: Read-only\n- **Example**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\nDebug.Print \"Current thread count: \" &amp; pool.ThreadCount\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### ActiveThreadCount\n- **Type**: Long\n- **Description**: Gets the current number of threads executing tasks\n- **Access Level**: Read-only\n- **Example**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\nDebug.Print \"Active thread count: \" &amp; pool.ActiveThreadCount\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### PendingTaskCount\n- **Type**: Long\n- **Description**: Gets the number of tasks waiting for execution\n- **Access Level**: Read-only\n- **Example**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\nDebug.Print \"Pending task count: \" &amp; pool.PendingTaskCount\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Methods\n\n#### Create\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\nPublic Function Create(ByVal threadCount As Long) As Boolean\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n- **Description**: Creates a thread pool with the specified number of threads\n- **Parameters**: \n  - threadCount: Number of threads to create\n- **Return Value**: Returns True if creation is successful\n- **Example**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\nDim pool As New cTasks\npool.Create 4  ' Create a pool with 4 threads\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### AddTask\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\nPublic Function AddTask(ByVal proc As LongPtr, _\n                       Optional ByVal param As Variant, _\n                       Optional ByVal priority As TaskPriority = Priority_Normal) As cTask\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n- **Description**: Adds a new task to the thread pool\n- **Parameters**:\n  - proc: Address of the task procedure\n  - param: Parameter to pass to the task (optional)\n  - priority: Task priority (optional)\n- **Return Value**: The newly created task object\n- **Example**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\nDim task As cTask\nSet task = pool.AddTask(AddressOf MyProc, \"parameter\", Priority_High)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### WaitForAll\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\nPublic Function WaitForAll(Optional ByVal timeout As Long = INFINITE) As Boolean\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n- **Description**: Waits for all tasks to complete\n- **Parameters**:\n  - timeout: Timeout in milliseconds, defaults to infinite wait\n- **Return Value**: Returns True if all tasks complete\n- **Example**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\n' Wait for all tasks to complete, maximum 10 seconds\nIf Not pool.WaitForAll(10000) Then\n    Debug.Print \"Some tasks did not complete\"\nEnd If\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Shutdown\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\nPublic Sub Shutdown(Optional ByVal graceful As Boolean = True)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n- **Description**: Shuts down the thread pool\n- **Parameters**:\n  - graceful: Whether to shut down gracefully, True waits for task completion\n- **Example**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\n' Graceful shutdown, wait for task completion\npool.Shutdown True\n\n' Force shutdown, don't wait for tasks\npool.Shutdown False\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### SetAutoScale\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\nPublic Sub SetAutoScale(ByVal enabled As Boolean, _\n                       Optional ByVal minThreads As Long = 2, _\n                       Optional ByVal loadFactor As Double = 0.75)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n- **Description**: Sets thread pool auto-scaling\n- **Parameters**:\n  - enabled: Whether to enable auto-scaling\n  - minThreads: Minimum number of threads\n  - loadFactor: Load factor (0-1)\n- **Example**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\n' Enable auto-scaling, minimum 2 threads, load factor 0.75\npool.SetAutoScale True, 2, 0.75\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## cTask Class\n\nThe task encapsulation class providing task control and state management.\n\n### Properties\n\n#### Status\n- **Type**: TaskStatus enumeration\n- **Description**: Gets the current status of the task\n- **Possible Values**:\n  - TaskStatus_Created: Created\n  - TaskStatus_Running: Running\n  - TaskStatus_Completed: Completed\n  - TaskStatus_Failed: Failed\n  - TaskStatus_Cancelled: Cancelled\n  - TaskStatus_TimedOut: Timed out\n\n#### IsRunning\n- **Type**: Boolean\n- **Description**: Whether the task is currently running\n\n#### IsCompleted\n- **Type**: Boolean\n- **Description**: Whether the task has completed\n\n#### Result\n- **Type**: Long\n- **Description**: Gets the task execution result\n\n### Methods\n\n#### Create\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\nPublic Function Create(ByVal proc As LongPtr, _\n                      Optional ByVal param As Variant) As Boolean\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n- **Description**: Creates a new task\n- **Parameters**:\n  - proc: Task procedure address\n  - param: Task parameter (optional)\n- **Return Value**: Returns True if creation is successful\n\n#### SetTimeout\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\nPublic Sub SetTimeout(ByVal milliseconds As Long)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n- **Description**: Sets task timeout\n- **Parameters**:\n  - milliseconds: Timeout in milliseconds\n\n#### SetRetryPolicy\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\nPublic Sub SetRetryPolicy(ByVal maxRetries As Long, _\n                         ByVal retryInterval As Long)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n- **Description**: Sets retry policy\n- **Parameters**:\n  - maxRetries: Maximum number of retries\n  - retryInterval: Retry interval in milliseconds\n\n#### SetOnComplete\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\nPublic Sub SetOnComplete(ByVal callback As LongPtr)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n- **Description**: Sets completion callback\n- **Parameters**:\n  - callback: Callback function address\n\n#### SetOnError\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\nPublic Sub SetOnError(ByVal callback As LongPtr)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n- **Description**: Sets error callback\n- **Parameters**:\n  - callback: Callback function address\n\n#### WaitForCompletion\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\nPublic Function WaitForCompletion(Optional ByVal timeout As Long = INFINITE) As Boolean\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n- **Description**: Waits for task completion\n- **Parameters**:\n  -   "textEditContent": "# Tutorials\n\n## Basic Usage\n\n### 1. Creating a Thread Pool\n\nThe most basic way to create a thread pool:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\n' Create a pool with 4 threads\nDim pool As New cTasks\npool.Create 4\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2. Adding Simple Tasks\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\n' Define task procedure\nPublic Function MyProc(ByVal param As Variant) As Long\n    ' Perform some operations\n    Debug.Print \"Processing task: \" &amp; param\n    Sleep 1000  ' Simulate time-consuming operation\n    MyProc = 0  ' Return success\nEnd Function\n\n' Add task to thread pool\nDim task As cTask\nSet task = pool.AddTask(AddressOf MyProc, \"Task1\")\n\n' Wait for task completion\ntask.WaitForCompletion\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 3. Using Task Callbacks\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\n' Completion callback\nPublic Function TaskCompleted(ByVal taskPtr As LongPtr, _\n                            ByVal result As Long, _\n                            ByVal wParam As LongPtr, _\n                            ByVal lParam As LongPtr) As Long\n    Dim task As cTask\n    Set task = mTask.ObjectFromPtr(taskPtr)\n    Debug.Print \"Task completed, result: \" &amp; result\n    TaskCompleted = 0\nEnd Function\n\n' Error callback\nPublic Function TaskError(ByVal taskPtr As LongPtr, _\n                         ByVal errorCode As Long, _\n                         ByVal wParam As LongPtr, _\n                         ByVal lParam As LongPtr) As Long\n    Dim task As cTask\n    Set task = mTask.ObjectFromPtr(taskPtr)\n    Debug.Print \"Task error: \" &amp; errorCode\n    TaskError = 0\nEnd Function\n\n' Set callbacks\nDim task As cTask\nSet task = pool.AddTask(AddressOf MyProc)\ntask.SetOnComplete AddressOf TaskCompleted\ntask.SetOnError AddressOf TaskError\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Advanced Usage\n\n### 1. Task Priority\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\n' Add high priority task\nDim highTask As cTask\nSet highTask = pool.AddTask(AddressOf MyProc, \"High Priority\", Priority_High)\n\n' Add normal priority task\nDim normalTask As cTask\nSet normalTask = pool.AddTask(AddressOf MyProc, \"Normal Priority\", Priority_Normal)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2. Task Timeout Control\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\n' Set task timeout\nDim task As cTask\nSet task = pool.AddTask(AddressOf MyProc)\ntask.SetTimeout 5000  ' 5 second timeout\n\n' Wait for task completion\nIf Not task.WaitForCompletion Then\n    Debug.Print \"Task timed out or failed\"\nEnd If\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 3. Task Retry Mechanism\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\n' Set retry policy\nDim task As cTask\nSet task = pool.AddTask(AddressOf MyProc)\ntask.SetRetryPolicy 3, 1000  ' Maximum 3 retries, 1 second interval\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 4. Batch Task Processing\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\n' Add multiple tasks\nDim tasks() As cTask\nReDim tasks(1 To 10)\n\n' Create 10 tasks\nDim i As Long\nFor i = 1 To 10\n    Set tasks(i) = pool.AddTask(AddressOf MyProc, \"Task\" &amp; i)\nNext i\n\n' Wait for all tasks to complete\npool.WaitForAll 10000  ' Maximum wait 10 seconds\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 5. Auto-Scaling Thread Pool\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\n' Create auto-scaling thread pool\nDim pool As New cTasks\npool.Create 4\npool.SetAutoScale True, 2, 0.75  ' Enable auto-scaling, minimum 2 threads, load factor 0.75\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Best Practices\n\n### 1. Error Handling\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\n' Error handling in task procedure\nPublic Function MyProc(ByVal param As Variant) As Long\n    On Error GoTo ErrorHandler\n    \n    ' Execute task...\n    \n    MyProc = 0  ' Success\n    Exit Function\n    \nErrorHandler:\n    MyProc = Err.Number  ' Return error code\nEnd Function\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2. Cancellation Support\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\n' Cancellable task procedure\nPublic Function CancellableProc(ByVal param As Variant) As Long\n    Dim task As cTask\n    Set task = mTask.ObjectFromPtr(param)\n    \n    Do\n        ' Check if cancellation is requested\n        If task.CancelRequested Then\n            CancellableProc = TaskResult_Cancelled\n            Exit Function\n        End If\n        \n        ' Perform some operations...\n        Sleep 100\n    Loop\n    \n    CancellableProc = 0\nEnd Function\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 3. Resource Cleanup\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\n' Graceful shutdown of thread pool\nPrivate Sub Class_Terminate()\n    If Not pool Is Nothing Then\n        pool.Shutdown True  ' Wait for task completion\n        Set pool = Nothing\n    End If\nEnd Sub\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 4. Performance Optimization\n\n1. Set Thread Count Appropriately\n   - Usually set to 1-2 times the number of CPU cores\n   - Consider task type (CPU-intensive or IO-intensive)\n\n2. Avoid Too Small Tasks\n   - Task execution time should be significantly greater than thread scheduling overhead\n   - Consider merging small tasks\n\n3. Use Task Batching\n   - Add tasks in batches rather than one by one\n   - Use WaitForAll instead of waiting individually\n\n4. Use Timeouts Appropriately\n   - Set reasonable timeout values for all tasks\n   - Avoid infinite waiting\n\n## Important Notes\n\n1. Thread Safety\n   - Task procedures should be thread-safe\n   - Shared resources need appropriate synchronization\n   \n2. Resource Management\n   - Properly release resources\n   - Avoid resource leaks\n   \n3. Error Handling\n   - Use error callbacks\n   - Log detailed error information\n   \n4. {

  "textEditContent": "# Examples\n\n## Basic Examples\n\n### 1. Simple Task Execution\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\n' Simple task procedure\nPublic Function SimpleTask(ByVal param As Variant) As Long\n    Debug.Print \"Executing task: \" &amp; param\n    Sleep 1000  ' Simulate time-consuming operation\n    SimpleTask = 0  ' Return success\nEnd Function\n\n' Usage example\nPublic Sub SimpleTaskDemo()\n    ' Create thread pool\n    Dim pool As New cTasks\n    pool.Create 4  ' 4 threads\n    \n    ' Add task\n    Dim task As cTask\n    Set task = pool.AddTask(AddressOf SimpleTask, \"Hello\")\n    \n    ' Wait for completion\n    task.WaitForCompletion\n    \n    ' Check result\n    If task.Result = 0 Then\n        Debug.Print \"Task completed successfully\"\n    Else\n        Debug.Print \"Task failed\"\n    End If\nEnd Sub\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2. Batch Task Processing\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\nPublic Sub BatchTaskDemo()\n    ' Create thread pool\n    Dim pool As New cTasks\n    pool.Create 4\n    \n    ' Create multiple tasks\n    Dim i As Long\n    For i = 1 To 10\n        pool.AddTask AddressOf SimpleTask, \"Task\" &amp; i\n    Next i\n    \n    ' Wait for all tasks to complete\n    If pool.WaitForAll(10000) Then  ' 10 second timeout\n        Debug.Print \"All tasks completed\"\n    Else\n        Debug.Print \"Some tasks did not complete\"\n    End If\nEnd Sub\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Intermediate Examples\n\n### 1. Tasks with Callbacks\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\n' Task completion callback\nPublic Function TaskCompleted(ByVal taskPtr As LongPtr, _\n                            ByVal result As Long, _\n                            ByVal wParam As LongPtr, _\n                            ByVal lParam As LongPtr) As Long\n    Dim task As cTask\n    Set task = mTask.ObjectFromPtr(taskPtr)\n    \n    Debug.Print \"Task completed: \" &amp; task.Tag\n    Debug.Print \"Execution time: \" &amp; task.ExecutionTime &amp; \"ms\"\n    \n    TaskCompleted = 0\nEnd Function\n\n' Error callback\nPublic Function TaskError(ByVal taskPtr As LongPtr, _\n                         ByVal errorCode As Long, _\n                         ByVal wParam As LongPtr, _\n                         ByVal lParam As LongPtr) As Long\n    Dim task As cTask\n    Set task = mTask.ObjectFromPtr(taskPtr)\n    \n    Debug.Print \"Task error: \" &amp; task.ErrorDescription\n    \n    TaskError = 0\nEnd Function\n\n' Usage example\nPublic Sub CallbackDemo()\n    Dim pool As New cTasks\n    pool.Create 4\n    \n    Dim task As cTask\n    Set task = pool.AddTask(AddressOf SimpleTask, \"Task with callback\")\n    \n    ' Set callbacks\n    task.SetOnComplete AddressOf TaskCompleted\n    task.SetOnError AddressOf TaskError\n    \n    ' Wait for completion\n    task.WaitForCompletion\nEnd Sub\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2. File Download Example\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\n' Download information structure\nPrivate Type DownloadInfo\n    Url As String\n    OutputFile As String\nEnd Type\n\n' Download procedure\nPublic Function DownloadProc(ByVal param As Variant) As Long\n    Dim info As DownloadInfo\n    info = param\n    \n    ' Create HTTP request\n    Dim http As Object\n    Set http = CreateObject(\"WinHttp.WinHttpRequest.5.1\")\n    \n    On Error GoTo ErrorHandler\n    \n    ' Send request\n    http.Open \"GET\", info.Url, False\n    http.Send\n    \n    ' Check response\n    If http.Status = 200 Then\n        ' Save file\n        Dim fNum As Integer\n        fNum = FreeFile\n        Open info.OutputFile For Binary As #fNum\n            Put #fNum, , http.ResponseBody\n        Close #fNum\n        DownloadProc = 0\n    Else\n        DownloadProc = http.Status\n    End If\n    Exit Function\n    \nErrorHandler:\n    DownloadProc = Err.Number\nEnd Function\n\n' Download demonstration\nPublic Sub DownloadDemo()\n    Dim pool As New cTasks\n    pool.Create 4\n    \n    ' Prepare download information\n    Dim info As DownloadInfo\n    info.Url = \"https://example.com/file.txt\"\n    info.OutputFile = \"C:\\download\\file.txt\"\n    \n    ' Create download task\n    Dim task As cTask\n    Set task = pool.AddTask(AddressOf DownloadProc, info)\n    \n    ' Set timeout and retry\n    task.SetTimeout 30000        ' 30 second timeout\n    task.SetRetryPolicy 3, 1000  ' Maximum 3 retries\n    \n    ' Wait for completion\n    If task.WaitForCompletion Then\n        If task.Result = 0 Then\n            Debug.Print \"Download successful\"\n        Else\n            Debug.Print \"Download failed: \" &amp; task.Result\n        End If\n    Else\n        Debug.Print \"Download timed out\"\n    End If\nEnd Sub\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Advanced Examples\n\n### 1. Task Dependency Chain\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\n' Dependency task example\nPublic Sub DependencyDemo()\n    Dim pool As New cTasks\n    pool.Create 4\n    \n    ' Create task chain\n    Dim task1 As cTask, task2 As cTask, task3 As cTask\n    \n    ' First task: prepare data\n    Set task1 = pool.AddTask(AddressOf PrepareData)\n    task1.Tag = \"Prepare Data\"\n    \n    ' Second task: process data\n    Set task2 = pool.AddTask(AddressOf ProcessData)\n    task2.Tag = \"Process Data\"\n    task2.AddDependency task1  ' Depends on task1\n    \n    ' Third task: save result\n    Set task3 = pool.AddTask(AddressOf SaveResult)\n    task3.Tag = \"Save Result\"\n    task3.AddDependency task2  ' Depends on task2\n    \n    ' Wait for entire chain to complete\n    pool.WaitForAll\nEnd Sub\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2. Auto-Scaling Thread Pool\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\n' Stress test task\nPublic Function StressTask(ByVal param As Variant) As Long\n    ' Simulate tasks with different loads\n    Dim duration As Long\n    duration = Int(Rnd * 5000) + 1000  ' 1-6 second random duration\n    Sleep duration\n    StressTask = 0\nEnd Function\n\n' Auto-scaling example\nPublic Sub AutoScaleDemo()\n    Dim pool As New cTasks\n    pool.Create 4  ' Initial 4 threads\n    \n    ' Configure auto-scaling\n    pool.SetAutoScale True, _\n        minThreads:=2, _\n        maxThreads:=8, _\n        loadFactor:=0.75\n    \n    ' Enable performance logging\n    pool.EnablePerformanceLog \"C:\\poolstress.log\"\n    \n    ' Add many tasks\n    Dim i As Long\n    For i = 1 To 50\n        pool.AddTask AddressOf StressTask, \"Stress Test\" &amp; i\n        Sleep 100  ' Add tasks with intervals\n    Next i\n    \n    ' Wait for all tasks to complete\n    pool.WaitForAll\n    \n    ' Output statistics\n    Debug.Print \"Average execution time: \" &amp; pool.AverageTaskTime &amp; \"ms\"\n    Debug.Print \"Peak thread count: \" &amp; pool.PeakThreadCount\nEnd Sub\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 3. Complex Error Handling\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\n' Error handling example\nPublic Sub ErrorHandlingDemo()\n    Dim pool As New cTasks\n    pool.Create 4\n    \n    ' Set global error handler\n    pool.SetErrorHandler AddressOf GlobalErrorHandler\n    \n    ' Add potentially failing task\n    Dim task As cTask\n    Set task = pool.AddTask(AddressOf RiskyTask)\n    \n    ' Set retry policy\n    task.SetRetryPolicy 3, 1000\n    \n    ' Set custom error handler\n    task.SetOnError AddressOf CustomErrorHandler\n    \n    ' Wait for completion\n    task.WaitForCompletion\n    \n    ' Check error status\n    If task.LastError &lt;&gt; 0 Then\n        Debug.Print \"Task failed:\"\n        Debug.Print \"Error code: \" &amp; task.LastError\n        Debug.Print \"Error description: \" &amp; task.ErrorDescription\n        Debug.Print \"Retry count: \" &amp; task.RetryCount\n    End If\nEnd Sub\n\n' Global error handler\nPublic Function GlobalErrorHandler(ByVal pool As cTasks, _\n                                 ByVal errorCode As Long) As Long\n    ' Log error\n    Debug.Print \"Thread pool error: \" &amp; errorCode\n    GlobalErrorHandler = True  ' Continue execution\nEnd Function\n\n' Custom error handler\nPublic Function CustomErrorHandler(ByVal taskPtr As LongPtr, _\n                                 ByVal errorCode As Long, _\n                                 ByVal wParam As LongPtr, _\n                                 ByVal lParam As LongPtr) As Long\n    Dim task As cTask\n    Set task = mTask.ObjectFromPtr(taskPtr)\n    \n    Select Case errorCode\n        Case 1001  ' Custom error code\n            ' Special handling\n            CustomErrorHandler = 1  ' Request retry\n        Case Else\n            ' Other errors\n            CustomErrorHandler = 0  ' No more retries\n    End Select\nEnd Function\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 4. UI Update Example\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\n' UI update example\nPublic Sub UiUpdateDemo()\n    Dim pool As New cTasks\n    pool.Create 4\n    \n    ' Create progress update task\n    Dim task As cTask\n    Set task = pool.AddTask(AddressOf LongProcess)\n    \n    ' Set progress callback\n    task.SetProgressCallback AddressOf UpdateProgress\n    \n    ' Wait for completion\n    task.WaitForCompletion\nEnd Sub\n\n' Progress update callback\nPublic Function UpdateProgress(ByVal taskPtr As LongPtr, _\n                             ByVal progress As Long, _\n                             ByVal wParam As LongPtr, _\n                             ByVal lParam As LongPtr) As Long\n    ' Note: This is called from worker thread\n    ' Need to use PostMessage to update UI\n    PostMessage FormHandle, WM_UPDATE_PROGRESS, progress, 0\n    UpdateProgress = 0\nEnd Function\n\n' Form code\nPrivate Sub Form_Message(ByVal msg As Long, _\n                        ByVal wParam As Long, _\n                        ByVal lParam As Long)\n    If msg = WM_UPDATE_PROGRESS Then\n        ' Update progress bar\n        ProgressBar1.Value = wParam\n    End If\nEnd Sub\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n",

  "textEditContent": "# Advanced Features\n\n## Task Priority Management\n\n### Priority Mechanism\n\nThe thread pool supports the following priority levels:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\nPublic Enum TaskPriority\n    Priority_Low = 0\n    Priority_Normal = 1\n    Priority_High = 2\n    Priority_Critical = 3\nEnd Enum\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Using Priorities\n\n1. Specify when creating tasks:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\n' Create high priority task\nDim task As cTask\nSet task = pool.AddTask(AddressOf MyProc, param, Priority_High)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n2. Dynamically modify priority:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\n' Modify existing task priority\ntask.Priority = Priority_Critical\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Priority Scheduling Strategy\n\n- High priority tasks execute first\n- Same priority tasks execute in FIFO order\n- Newly added high priority tasks can preempt low priority tasks in the waiting queue\n\n## Error Handling Mechanism\n\n### Error States\n\nPossible error states for tasks:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\nPublic Enum TaskResult\n    TaskResult_Success = 0\n    TaskResult_Failed = 1\n    TaskResult_Cancelled = 2\n    TaskResult_TimedOut = 3\n    TaskResult_Exception = 4\nEnd Enum\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Error Tracking\n\nEach task maintains detailed error information:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\n' Get error information\nDebug.Print \"Error code: \" &amp; task.LastError\nDebug.Print \"Error description: \" &amp; task.ErrorDescription\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Error Callbacks\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\n' Error handling callback\nPublic Function OnError(ByVal taskPtr As LongPtr, _\n                       ByVal errorCode As Long, _\n                       ByVal wParam As LongPtr, _\n                       ByVal lParam As LongPtr) As Long\n    Dim task As cTask\n    Set task = mTask.ObjectFromPtr(taskPtr)\n    \n    ' Log error\n    Debug.Print \"Task failed: \" &amp; task.ErrorDescription\n    \n    ' Decide whether to retry\n    If errorCode = SomeRetryableError Then\n        OnError = 1  ' Return 1 indicates retry needed\n    Else\n        OnError = 0  ' Return 0 indicates no more retries\n    End If\nEnd Function\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Performance Monitoring\n\n### Statistical Information\n\nThe thread pool provides detailed performance statistics:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\n' Get thread pool statistics\nDebug.Print \"Total threads: \" &amp; pool.ThreadCount\nDebug.Print \"Active threads: \" &amp; pool.ActiveThreadCount\nDebug.Print \"Pending tasks: \" &amp; pool.PendingTaskCount\nDebug.Print \"Completed tasks: \" &amp; pool.CompletedTaskCount\nDebug.Print \"Average execution time: \" &amp; pool.AverageTaskTime &amp; \"ms\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Performance Logging\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\n' Enable performance logging\npool.EnablePerformanceLog \"C:\\threadpool.log\"\n\n' Log content example:\n' 2023-09-05 10:30:15 Task started ID=1\n' 2023-09-05 10:30:16 Task completed ID=1 execution time=1023ms\n' 2023-09-05 10:30:16 Thread pool status: active=3/4 pending=5\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Automatic Load Balancing\n\n### Auto-Scaling Configuration\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\n' Configure auto-scaling\npool.SetAutoScale True, _\n    minThreads:=2, _       ' Minimum threads\n    maxThreads:=8, _       ' Maximum threads\n    loadFactor:=0.75       ' Load factor\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Scaling Trigger Conditions\n\n- Current load = active threads / total threads\n- If current load &gt; loadFactor, attempt to increase threads\n- If current load &lt; loadFactor/2, attempt to decrease threads\n- Always maintain minimum thread count\n\n### Load Monitoring\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\n' Get current load situation\nDim load As Double\nload = pool.GetCurrentLoad  ' Returns value between 0-1\n\n' Adjust strategy based on load\nIf load &gt; 0.9 Then\n    ' Load too high, can temporarily increase thread count\n    pool.SetMaxThreads pool.ThreadCount + 2\nEnd If\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Task Dependency Management\n\n### Setting Task Dependencies\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\n' Create dependent tasks\nDim task1 As cTask, task2 As cTask\nSet task1 = pool.AddTask(AddressOf Proc1)\nSet task2 = pool.AddTask(AddressOf Proc2)\n\n' Set dependency relationship\ntask2.AddDependency task1  ' task2 depends on task1\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Dependency Execution Rules\n\n- Dependent tasks must wait for prerequisite tasks to complete\n- If prerequisite task fails, dependent task will not execute\n- Supports multiple dependencies (AND relationship)\n\n### Dependency Chain Example\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\n' Create task chain\nDim task1 As cTask, task2 As cTask, task3 As cTask\nSet task1 = pool.AddTask(AddressOf Step1)\nSet task2 = pool.AddTask(AddressOf Step2)\nSet task3 = pool.AddTask(AddressOf Step3)\n\n' Set dependency chain\ntask2.AddDependency task1\ntask3.AddDependency task2\n\n' Start task chain\ntask1.Start\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Resource Management\n\n### Thread Pool Resource Control\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\n' Set thread pool resource limits\npool.SetResourceLimits _\n    maxMemory:=1024 * 1024 * 100, _  ' 100MB memory limit\n    maxCpu:=75                        ' Maximum 75% CPU usage\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Resource Monitoring\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\n' Monitor resource usage\nDim memUsage As Long\nmemUsage = pool.GetMemoryUsage  ' Get current memory usage\n\n' Adjust strategy based on resource usage\nIf memUsage &gt; pool.MaxMemory * 0.9 Then\n    ' Memory usage approaching limit, take action\n    pool.PauseNewTasks  ' Pause accepting new tasks\nEnd If\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Task Cancellation and Timeout\n\n### Cancellation Mechanism\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\n' Cancellable task procedure\nPublic Function CancellableProc(ByVal param As Variant) As Long\n    Dim task As cTask\n    Set task = mTask.ObjectFromPtr(param)\n    \n    Do\n        If task.CancelRequested Then\n            ' Clean up resources\n            CleanupResources\n            CancellableProc = TaskResult_Cancelled\n            Exit Function\n        End If\n        \n        ' Execute task steps...\n        \n    Loop\nEnd Function\n\n' Request task cancellation\ntask.RequestCancel\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Timeout Handling\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\n' Set task timeout\ntask.SetTimeout 5000  ' 5 second timeout\n\n' Timeout callback\nPublic Function OnTimeout(ByVal taskPtr As LongPtr) As Long\n    Dim task As cTask\n    Set task = mTask.ObjectFromPtr(taskPtr)\n    \n    ' Perform timeout cleanup\n    CleanupResources\n    \n    OnTimeout = TaskResult_TimedOut\nEnd Function\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Logging and Debugging\n\n### Enable Debug Logging\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\n' Configure logging\npool.SetLogLevel LogLevel_Debug\npool.SetLogFile \"C:\\threadpool_debug.log\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Log Callbacks\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\n' Custom log handling\nPublic Function LogHandler(ByVal level As Long, _\n                         ByVal message As String) As Long\n    ' Handle log messages\n    Select Case level\n        Case LogLevel_Error\n            LogToEventLog message\n        Case LogLevel_Debug\n            Debug.Print message\n    End Select\nEnd Function\n\n' Set log callback\npool.SetLogCallback AddressOf LogHandler\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n",

  "textEditContent": "# Task Data and Result Management\n\n## Overview\nThe ThreadPool library provides a flexible mechanism for task data passing and result storage. Through the &#96;TaskData&#96; and &#96;TaskResult&#96; collections, we can conveniently pass and store various types of data before, during, and after task execution.\n\n## Key Features\n\n1. **Type Safety**\n   - Supports arbitrary types of data, including basic types and objects\n   - Automatically handles assignment of object and non-object types\n\n2. **Named Parameters**\n   - Uses string keys to access data\n   - Clearer and more structured than traditional &#96;Tag&#96; properties\n   - Supports simultaneous storage of multiple parameters and results\n\n3. **Thread Safety**\n   - All data access is protected by mutexes\n   - Ensures data consistency in multithreaded environments\n\n4. **Flexibility**\n   - Supports dynamic addition and modification of data\n   - Can update results at any time during task execution\n   - Supports passing of complex data structures\n\n## API Reference\n\n### TaskData Related Methods\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\n' Set task input parameters\nPublic Sub SetTaskData(ByVal Key As String, ByVal Value As Variant)\n\n' Get task input parameters\nPublic Function GetTaskData(ByVal Key As String) As Variant\n\n' Clear all task data\nPublic Sub ClearTaskData()\n\n' Get all task data keys\nPublic Function GetTaskDataKeys() As Collection\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### TaskResult Related Methods\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\n' Set task result\nPublic Sub SetTaskResult(ByVal Key As String, ByVal Value As Variant)\n\n' Get task result\nPublic Function GetTaskResult(ByVal Key As String) As Variant\n\n' Clear all task results\nPublic Sub ClearTaskResults()\n\n' Get all task result keys\nPublic Function GetTaskResultKeys() As Collection\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Usage Examples\n\n### Basic Usage\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\n' Create task and set input parameters\nDim task As New cTask\nWith task\n    .SetTaskData \"url\", \"http://example.com\"\n    .SetTaskData \"timeout\", 5000\n    .SetTaskData \"headers\", CreateObject(\"Scripting.Dictionary\")\nEnd With\n\n' Start task\ntask.Create AddressOf DownloadTaskProc\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Using in Task Procedures\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\nPublic Function DownloadTaskProc(ByVal param As LongPtr) As Long\n    Dim task As cTask\n    Set task = mTask.ObjectFromPtr(param)\n    \n    ' Get input parameters\n    Dim url As String\n    url = task.GetTaskData(\"url\")\n    Dim timeout As Long\n    timeout = task.GetTaskData(\"timeout\")\n    \n    ' Perform download...\n    \n    ' Set results\n    task.SetTaskResult \"statusCode\", 200\n    task.SetTaskResult \"content\", content\n    task.SetTaskResult \"responseTime\", Timer\n    task.SetTaskResult \"headers\", responseHeaders\n    \n    DownloadTaskProc = 0\nEnd Function\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Processing Results in Callbacks\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\nPublic Function TaskCompletedCallback(ByVal taskPtr As LongPtr, _\n                                    ByVal result As Long, _\n                                    ByVal wParam As LongPtr, _\n                                    ByVal lParam As LongPtr) As Long\n    Dim task As cTask\n    Set task = mTask.ObjectFromPtr(taskPtr)\n    \n    ' Get results\n    Dim statusCode As Long\n    statusCode = task.GetTaskResult(\"statusCode\")\n    Dim content As String\n    content = task.GetTaskResult(\"content\")\n    \n    ' Process results...\n    Debug.Print \"Download completed: Status=\" &amp; statusCode &amp; _\n                \", Content length=\" &amp; Len(content)\n    \n    TaskCompletedCallback = 0\nEnd Function\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Best Practices\n\n1. **Parameter Naming Conventions**\n   - Use clear, descriptive key names\n   - Recommend using camelCase naming\n   - Related parameters can use common prefixes\n\n2. **Error Handling**\n   - Always check return values of GetTaskData/GetTaskResult\n   - Use On Error to handle possible exceptions\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\nOn Error Resume Next\nDim value As Variant\nvalue = task.GetTaskData(\"someKey\")\nIf Err.Number &lt;&gt; 0 Then\n    ' Handle error...\n    Exit Function\nEnd If\nOn Error GoTo 0\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n3. **Resource Management**\n   - Clean up data no longer needed promptly (use ClearTaskData/ClearTaskResults)\n   - For large objects, set to Nothing after use\n\n4. **Concurrency Considerations**\n   - Avoid overly long data access operations\n   - Consider using additional synchronization mechanisms in critical sections\n\n## Application Scenarios\n\n1. **Web Request Processing**\n   - Pass URL, headers, request parameters\n   - Store response status, content, metadata\n\n2. **File Operations**\n   - Pass file paths, operation options\n   - Store processing results, statistics\n\n3. **Data Processing**\n   - Pass datasets, processing parameters\n   - Store processing results, statistical data\n\n4. **Multi-step Tasks**\n   - Pass data between different steps\n   - Accumulate intermediate results\n\n## Important Notes\n\n1. Avoid storing overly large data objects, which may affect performance\n2. Clean up data no longer needed promptly\n3. Pay attention to lock usage in high-concurrency scenarios\n4. Recommend providing default values for critical data\n5. Regularly check and maintain data consistency\n\n## Summary\n\nThe TaskData and TaskResult mechanism provides a powerful and flexible way to handle task-related data passing and result storage.   "textEditContent": "# ThreadPool Performance Optimization Guide\n\n## 1. Data Passing Optimization\n\n### Large Data Processing\n- Use references instead of value passing for large datasets\n- Consider using files or databases as intermediate storage\n- Use data chunking processing\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\n' Recommended: Use reference passing for large data\nDim largeData As Dictionary\nSet largeData = New Dictionary\n' ... populate data ...\ntask.SetTaskData \"data\", largeData  ' Reference passing\n\n' Not recommended: Direct passing of large strings or arrays\ntask.SetTaskData \"data\", largeString  ' Value passing may cause performance issues\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Memory Management\n- Clean up unneeded data promptly\n- Use data streaming instead of loading all at once\n- Implement custom memory pool mechanisms\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\n' Clean up large objects after use\nPublic Sub CleanupTask(task As cTask)\n    Dim obj As Object\n    Set obj = task.GetTaskResult(\"largeObject\")\n    If Not obj Is Nothing Then\n        ' Clean up object resources\n        obj.Cleanup  ' Assuming object has cleanup method\n        Set obj = Nothing\n    End If\n    task.ClearTaskResults\nEnd Sub\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 2. Concurrency Optimization\n\n### Task Splitting\n- Split large tasks into smaller tasks\n- Use appropriate task granularity\n- Implement task queue prioritization\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\n' Task splitting example\nPublic Function SplitTask(data As Variant, chunkSize As Long) As Collection\n    Dim tasks As New Collection\n    Dim i As Long\n    \n    For i = 1 To Length(data) Step chunkSize\n        Dim task As New cTask\n        With task\n            .SetTaskData \"startIndex\", i\n            .SetTaskData \"endIndex\", Min(i + chunkSize - 1, Length(data))\n            .SetTaskData \"data\", GetDataChunk(data, i, chunkSize)\n            .Priority = CalculatePriority(i)\n        End With\n        tasks.Add task\n    Next i\n    \n    Set SplitTask = tasks\nEnd Function\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Resource Control\n- Implement resource pools\n- Control concurrent task count\n- Monitor resource usage\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\n' Resource pool implementation\nPrivate Type ResourcePool\n    Available As Collection\n    InUse As Collection\n    MaxSize As Long\nEnd Type\n\nPrivate Function AcquireResource(pool As ResourcePool) As Variant\n    If pool.Available.Count &gt; 0 Then\n        Set AcquireResource = pool.Available(1)\n        pool.Available.Remove 1\n        pool.InUse.Add AcquireResource\n    End If\nEnd Function\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 3. Lock Optimization\n\n### Fine-Grained Locking\n- Reduce critical section scope\n- Use multiple dedicated locks\n- Avoid lock nesting\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\n' Before improvement: Coarse-grained locking\nPublic Sub CoarseGrainedLock()\n    LockState\n    ' Perform multiple operations...\n    UnlockState\nEnd Sub\n\n' After improvement: Fine-grained locking\nPublic Sub FineGrainedLock()\n    ' Lock only necessary operations\n    LockState\n    Dim value As Variant\n    value = m_TaskData(\"key\")\n    UnlockState\n    \n    ' Perform operations that don't need locking...\n    \n    LockState\n    m_TaskResult.Add result, \"key\"\n    UnlockState\nEnd Sub\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Read-Write Separation\n- Implement read-write locks\n- Optimize frequent read operations\n- Batch update mechanisms\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\nPrivate Type ReadWriteLock\n    ReadCount As Long\n    WriteCount As Long\n    ReadMutex As LongPtr\n    WriteMutex As LongPtr\nEnd Type\n\n' Read lock implementation\nPrivate Sub AcquireReadLock(lock As ReadWriteLock)\n    WaitForSingleObject lock.ReadMutex, INFINITE\n    lock.ReadCount = lock.ReadCount + 1\n    If lock.ReadCount = 1 Then\n        WaitForSingleObject lock.WriteMutex, INFINITE\n    End If\n    ReleaseMutex lock.ReadMutex\nEnd Sub\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 4. Monitoring and Diagnostics\n\n### Performance Metrics Collection\n- Record critical operation times\n- Track resource usage\n- Implement performance counters\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\n' Performance monitoring wrapper\nPrivate Function MeasurePerformance(task As cTask, operation As String) As Double\n    Dim startTime As Currency\n    QueryPerformanceCounter startTime\n    \n    ' Perform operation...\n    \n    Dim endTime As Currency\n    QueryPerformanceCounter endTime\n    \n    Dim freq As Currency\n    QueryPerformanceFrequency freq\n    \n    MeasurePerformance = (endTime - startTime) / freq * 1000\n    \n    ' Record performance data\n    task.SetTaskResult \"perf_\" &amp; operation, MeasurePerformance\nEnd Function\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Diagnostic Information\n- Implement detailed logging\n- Add performance tracking points\n- Export diagnostic data\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\n' Diagnostic logging\nPrivate Sub LogDiagnostics(task As cTask, category As String, message As String)\n    Dim logEntry As String\n    logEntry = Format$(Now, \"yyyy-mm-dd hh:nn:ss.000\") &amp; \" | \" &amp; _\n               category &amp; \" | \" &amp; _\n               \"Task[\" &amp; task.ThreadID &amp; \"] | \" &amp; _\n               message\n               \n    ' Add detailed information\n    If task.GetTaskResult(\"diagnostics\") = Empty Then\n        task.SetTaskResult \"diagnostics\", CreateObject(\"Scripting.Dictionary\")\n    End If\n    \n    Dim diag As Object\n    Set diag = task.GetTaskResult(\"diagnostics\")\n    diag.Add Now, logEntry\nEnd Sub\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 5. Best Practice Recommendations\n\n### Code Optimization\n1. Pre-allocate collection sizes\n2. Use appropriate data structures\n3. Avoid unnecessary object creation\n4. Implement object pool patterns\n\n### Concurrency Control\n1. Avoid holding locks for long periods\n2. Use non-blocking algorithms\n3. Implement task timeout mechanisms\n4. Set task priorities appropriately\n\n### Resource Management\n1. Release resources promptly\n2. Implement resource limits\n3. Monitor resource leaks\n4. Regularly clean caches\n\n### Error Handling\n1. Implement graceful degradation\n2. Add retry mechanisms\n3. Record detailed error information\n4. Implement automatic recovery mechanisms\n",

}

  "textEditContent": "# ThreadPool Feature Integration Guide\n\n&gt; Important Note: ThreadPool has built-in implementations of the following core features:\n&gt; - ⚡ Timeout handling (&#96;SetTimeout&#96;, &#96;HandleTimeout&#96;)\n&gt; - 🔄 Retry mechanism (&#96;SetRetryPolicy&#96;, &#96;MaxRetries&#96;, &#96;RetryDelay&#96;)\n&gt; - 📊 Performance monitoring (&#96;ExecutionTime&#96;, task status tracking)\n&gt; - ⏸️ Pause/Resume (&#96;Pause&#96;, &#96;Resume&#96;)\n&gt; - ❌ Cancellation support (&#96;RequestCancel&#96;, &#96;CancelRequested&#96;)\n&gt; - 📝 Logging (&#96;EnableLogging&#96;, &#96;WriteLog&#96;)\n&gt; \n&gt; This document shows how to combine these built-in features with the new TaskData/Result mechanism to build more powerful task processing solutions.\n\n## 1. Timeout Handling and TaskData/Result Integration\n\n### Utilizing Built-in Timeout Features\n\n### Extending Built-in Timeout Functionality\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\n' ThreadPool already has built-in timeout handling, this shows how to extend it\nWith New cTask\n    ' Use built-in timeout mechanism\n    .SetTimeout 30000                        ' Set overall timeout (built-in feature)\n    \n    ' Use TaskData/Result to extend timeout handling capabilities\n    .SetTaskData \"subOperationTimeout\", 5000 ' Sub-operation timeout\n    .SetTaskData \"timeoutAction\", \"retry\"    ' Custom timeout behavior\n    .SetTaskData \"timeoutRetries\", 3         ' Retry count after timeout\nEnd With\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Timeout Handling and Result Recording\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\nPublic Function TimeoutAwareTaskProc(ByVal param As LongPtr) As Long\n    Dim task As cTask\n    Set task = mTask.ObjectFromPtr(param)\n    \n    ' Get timeout configuration\n    Dim operationTimeout As Long\n    operationTimeout = task.GetTaskData(\"operationTimeout\")\n    \n    ' Execute operation and record timeout situation\n    task.SetTaskResult \"startTime\", Now\n    \n    Dim success As Boolean\n    success = PerformOperation(operationTimeout)\n    \n    If Not success Then\n        task.SetTaskResult \"timedOut\", True\n        task.SetTaskResult \"timeoutDuration\", operationTimeout\n        task.SetTaskResult \"failurePoint\", \"operation\"\n    End If\n    \n    TimeoutAwareTaskProc = IIf(success, 0, 1)\nEnd Function\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 2. Retry Mechanism and State Management\n\n### Enhancing Built-in Retry Functionality\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\nPublic Sub ConfigureTaskWithRetry(task As cTask)\n    ' Use built-in retry mechanism\n    task.SetRetryPolicy 3, 1000  ' Set max retries and delay (built-in feature)\n    \n    ' Use TaskData/Result to extend retry functionality\n    task.SetTaskData \"retryBackoff\", 2    ' Custom exponential backoff coefficient\n    task.SetTaskData \"retryConditions\", CreateRetryConditions() ' Custom retry conditions\n    \n    ' Retry status tracking\n    task.SetTaskResult \"retryCount\", 0\n    task.SetTaskResult \"retryHistory\", CreateObject(\"Scripting.Dictionary\")\nEnd Sub\n\nPublic Function RetryAwareTaskProc(ByVal param As LongPtr) As Long\n    Dim task As cTask\n    Set task = mTask.ObjectFromPtr(param)\n    \n    Dim retryCount As Long\n    retryCount = task.GetTaskResult(\"retryCount\")\n    \n    ' Execute operation\n    Dim success As Boolean\n    success = PerformOperation()\n    \n    ' Update retry history\n    Dim history As Object\n    Set history = task.GetTaskResult(\"retryHistory\")\n    history.Add Now, \"Attempt \" &amp; (retryCount + 1) &amp; \": \" &amp; IIf(success, \"Success\", \"Failed\")\n    \n    ' Update retry count\n    task.SetTaskResult \"retryCount\", retryCount + 1\n    \n    RetryAwareTaskProc = IIf(success, 0, 1)\nEnd Function\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 3. Progress Reporting and Task Control\n\n### Combining Built-in Control Features\n&gt; ThreadPool already provides &#96;Pause&#96;, &#96;Resume&#96;, &#96;RequestCancel&#96; and other control features.\n&gt; The following shows how to use TaskData/Result to enhance these features.\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\nPublic Function ProgressAwareTaskProc(ByVal param As LongPtr) As Long\n    Dim task As cTask\n    Set task = mTask.ObjectFromPtr(param)\n    \n    ' Initialize progress information\n    task.SetTaskResult \"progress\", 0\n    task.SetTaskResult \"status\", \"initializing\"\n    task.SetTaskResult \"startTime\", Now\n    task.SetTaskResult \"estimatedCompletion\", Empty\n    \n    ' Processing\n    Dim totalSteps As Long\n    totalSteps = task.GetTaskData(\"totalSteps\")\n    \n    For i = 1 To totalSteps\n        If task.CancelRequested Then\n            ' Record cancellation status\n            task.SetTaskResult \"cancelTime\", Now\n            task.SetTaskResult \"cancelReason\", \"user_requested\"\n            task.SetTaskResult \"lastCompletedStep\", i - 1\n            Exit For\n        End If\n        \n        ' Update progress\n        UpdateTaskProgress task, i, totalSteps\n        \n        ' Execute step...\n    Next i\n    \n    ProgressAwareTaskProc = 0\nEnd Function\n\nPrivate Sub UpdateTaskProgress(task As cTask, currentStep As Long, totalSteps As Long)\n    Dim progress As Double\n    progress = currentStep / totalSteps * 100\n    \n    ' Update progress information\n    task.SetTaskResult \"progress\", progress\n    task.SetTaskResult \"currentStep\", currentStep\n    task.SetTaskResult \"status\", \"processing\"\n    \n    ' Calculate estimated completion time\n    If currentStep &gt; 1 Then\n        Dim startTime As Date\n        startTime = task.GetTaskResult(\"startTime\")\n        Dim timePerStep As Double\n        timePerStep = DateDiff(\"s\", startTime, Now) / (currentStep - 1)\n        Dim remainingSteps As Long\n        remainingSteps = totalSteps - currentStep\n        Dim estimatedCompletion As Date\n        estimatedCompletion = DateAdd(\"s\", timePerStep * remainingSteps, Now)\n        \n        task.SetTaskResult \"estimatedCompletion\", estimatedCompletion\n    End If\nEnd Sub\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 4. Logging and Debug Integration\n\n### Extending Built-in Logging Features\n&gt; ThreadPool already has basic logging functionality (through &#96;EnableLogging&#96; and &#96;WriteLog&#96;).\n&gt; The following shows how to use TaskData/Result to build a more powerful logging and debugging system.\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\nPrivate Sub LogTaskEvent(task As cTask, eventType As String, message As String)\n    ' Ensure log container exists\n    If task.GetTaskResult(\"eventLog\") = Empty Then\n        task.SetTaskResult \"eventLog\", CreateObject(\"Scripting.Dictionary\")\n    End If\n    \n    Dim log As Object\n    Set log = task.GetTaskResult(\"eventLog\")\n    \n    ' Create log entry\n    Dim entry As New Dictionary\n    With entry\n        .Add \"timestamp\", Now\n        .Add \"type\", eventType\n        .Add \"message\", message\n        .Add \"taskId\", task.ThreadID\n        .Add \"progress\", task.GetTaskResult(\"progress\")\n        .Add \"status\", task.GetTaskResult(\"status\")\n    End With\n    \n    ' Add to log\n    log.Add log.Count + 1, entry\n    \n    ' Write to file if needed\n    If task.GetTaskData(\"logToFile\") Then\n        WriteLogToFile task, entry\n    End If\nEnd Sub\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Debug Assistance Features\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\nPublic Function GetTaskDebugInfo(task As cTask) As Dictionary\n    Dim debug As New Dictionary\n    \n    ' Basic information\n    debug.Add \"threadId\", task.ThreadID\n    debug.Add \"status\", task.GetTaskResult(\"status\")\n    debug.Add \"runtime\", DateDiff(\"s\", task.GetTaskResult(\"startTime\"), Now)\n    \n    ' Performance metrics\n    debug.Add \"progress\", task.GetTaskResult(\"progress\")\n    debug.Add \"memoryUsage\", GetTaskMemoryUsage(task)\n    \n    ' Error information\n    If task.GetTaskResult(\"lastError\") &lt;&gt; Empty Then\n        debug.Add \"lastError\", task.GetTaskResult(\"lastError\")\n        debug.Add \"errorTimestamp\", task.GetTaskResult(\"errorTime\")\n    End If\n    \n    ' Retry information\n    debug.Add \"retryCount\", task.GetTaskResult(\"retryCount\")\n    debug.Add \"retryHistory\", task.GetTaskResult(\"retryHistory\")\n    \n    Set GetTaskDebugInfo = debug\nEnd Function\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 5. Combining Built-in Features with Extended Functionality\n\n### Complete Example: Integrating All Features\n&gt; This example shows how to combine ThreadPool's built-in features (timeout, retry, logging, etc.)\n&gt; with the TaskData/Result mechanism to build a fully-featured task processing system.\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\nPublic Function ComplexTaskProc(ByVal param As LongPtr) As Long\n    Dim task As cTask\n    Set task = mTask.ObjectFromPtr(param)\n    \n    ' Initialize\n    InitializeTaskTracking task\n    \n    Do While ShouldRetry(task)\n        ' Update retry status\n        UpdateRetryStatus task\n        \n        ' Execute operation with timeout\n        Dim success As Boolean\n        success = ExecuteWithTimeout(task)\n        \n        If success Then\n            ' Record success\n            LogTaskSuccess task\n            ComplexTaskProc = 0\n            Exit Function\n        Else\n            ' Record failure\n            LogTaskFailure task\n            \n            ' Check if should retry\n            If Not ShouldRetry(task) Then\n                ComplexTaskProc = 1\n                Exit Function\n            End If\n            \n            ' Wait for retry\n            WaitForRetry task\n        End If\n    Loop\n    \n    ComplexTaskProc = 1\nEnd Function\n\nPrivate Sub InitializeTaskTracking(task As cTask)\n    ' Initialize all tracking states\n    With task\n        .SetTaskResult \"attempts\", 0\n        .SetTaskResult \"startTime\", Now\n        .SetTaskResult \"status\", \"initialized\"\n        .SetTaskResult \"lastError\", Empty\n        .SetTaskResult \"progress\", 0\n    End With\nEnd Sub\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Summary\n\nBy properly integrating various features, you can build robust, monitorable, high-performance task processing systems. Key points include:\n\n1. Use TaskData/Result to store configuration and state\n2. Implement comprehensive progress and status tracking\n3. Provide detailed logging and debugging information\n4. Handle timeouts and retries gracefully\n5. Support cancellation and cleanup operations\n\nThe combined use of these features can significantly improve the reliability and maintainability of task processing.\n",

Batch File Processing\n\n### Image Processing Task\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\nPublic Function ImageProcessTaskProc(ByVal param As LongPtr) As Long\n    Dim task As cTask\n    Set task = mTask.ObjectFromPtr(param)\n    \n    ' Get processing parameters\n    Dim inputPath As String: inputPath = task.GetTaskData(\"inputPath\")\n    Dim outputPath As String: outputPath = task.GetTaskData(\"outputPath\")\n    Dim quality As Long: quality = task.GetTaskData(\"quality\")\n    Dim maxSize As Long: maxSize = task.GetTaskData(\"maxSize\")\n    \n    ' Record progress during processing\n    task.SetTaskResult \"status\", \"processing\"\n    task.SetTaskResult \"progress\", 0\n    \n    ' Execute image processing...\n    \n    ' Record results\n    task.SetTaskResult \"outputSize\", FileLen(outputPath)\n    task.SetTaskResult \"processingTime\", Timer - startTime\n    task.SetTaskResult \"status\", \"completed\"\n    \n    ImageProcessTaskProc = 0\nEnd Function\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Data Export Task\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\n' Create export task\nWith New cTask\n    .SetTaskData \"format\", \"CSV\"\n    .SetTaskData \"query\", \"SELECT * FROM Sales WHERE Year = 2025\"\n    .SetTaskData \"parameters\", CreateObject(\"Scripting.Dictionary\")\n    .SetTaskData \"outputPath\", \"D:\\exports\\sales_2025.csv\"\n    .Create AddressOf ExportTaskProc\nEnd With\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 2. Asynchronous API Calls\n\n### Web API Request Chain\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\nPublic Function ChainedAPITaskProc(ByVal param As LongPtr) As Long\n    Dim task As cTask\n    Set task = mTask.ObjectFromPtr(param)\n    \n    ' First API call\n    task.SetTaskResult \"step1Status\", \"running\"\n    ' ... execute call ...\n    task.SetTaskResult \"step1Result\", response1\n    \n    ' Execute second call based on first call result\n    Dim response1 As Dictionary\n    Set response1 = task.GetTaskResult(\"step1Result\")\n    \n    task.SetTaskResult \"step2Status\", \"running\"\n    ' ... execute second call ...\n    task.SetTaskResult \"step2Result\", response2\n    \n    ChainedAPITaskProc = 0\nEnd Function\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 3. Real-time Data Processing\n\n### Stock Data Monitoring\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\nPublic Function StockMonitorTaskProc(ByVal param As LongPtr) As Long\n    Dim task As cTask\n    Set task = mTask.ObjectFromPtr(param)\n    \n    Dim symbols As Variant\n    symbols = task.GetTaskData(\"symbols\")  ' Stock symbol array\n    Dim interval As Long\n    interval = task.GetTaskData(\"interval\") ' Update interval\n    \n    Do While Not task.CancelRequested\n        ' Get latest data\n        task.SetTaskResult \"lastUpdate\", Now\n        task.SetTaskResult \"prices\", GetCurrentPrices(symbols)\n        \n        ' Check alert conditions\n        CheckAlertConditions task\n        \n        Sleep interval\n    Loop\n    \n    StockMonitorTaskProc = 0\nEnd Function\n\nPrivate Sub CheckAlertConditions(task As cTask)\n    Dim alerts As Dictionary\n    Set alerts = task.GetTaskData(\"alertConditions\")\n    \n    ' Process alerts...\n    task.SetTaskResult \"triggeredAlerts\", triggeredAlerts\nEnd Sub\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 4. Multi-task Cooperation\n\n### Master-Worker Task Pattern\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\n' Master task\nPublic Function MasterTaskProc(ByVal param As LongPtr) As Long\n    Dim task As cTask\n    Set task = mTask.ObjectFromPtr(param)\n    \n    ' Create sub-task list\n    Dim subTasks As New Collection\n    For i = 1 To 5\n        Dim subTask As New cTask\n        With subTask\n            .SetTaskData \"masterTask\", task\n            .SetTaskData \"workerId\", i\n            .Create AddressOf WorkerTaskProc\n        End With\n        subTasks.Add subTask\n    Next i\n    \n    ' Wait for all sub-tasks to complete\n    task.SetTaskResult \"subTasks\", subTasks\n    WaitForSubTasks subTasks\n    \n    ' Merge results\n    MergeResults task, subTasks\n    \n    MasterTaskProc = 0\nEnd Function\n\n' Worker task\nPublic Function WorkerTaskProc(ByVal param As LongPtr) As Long\n    Dim task As cTask\n    Set task = mTask.ObjectFromPtr(param)\n    \n    Dim workerId As Long\n    workerId = task.GetTaskData(\"workerId\")\n    \n    ' Execute assigned work...\n    task.SetTaskResult \"workerResult\", result\n    \n    WorkerTaskProc = 0\nEnd Function\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 5. Progress Reporting and Status Updates\n\n### Long-running Task\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\nPublic Function LongRunningTaskProc(ByVal param As LongPtr) As Long\n    Dim task As cTask\n    Set task = mTask.ObjectFromPtr(param)\n    \n    Dim totalSteps As Long\n    totalSteps = task.GetTaskData(\"totalSteps\")\n    \n    For i = 1 To totalSteps\n        If task.CancelRequested Then Exit For\n        \n        ' Update progress\n        task.SetTaskResult \"currentStep\", i\n        task.SetTaskResult \"progress\", i / totalSteps * 100\n        task.SetTaskResult \"status\", \"Processing step \" &amp; i\n        \n        ' Execute step...\n        \n        ' Update step result\n        task.SetTaskResult \"step\" &amp; i &amp; \"Result\", stepResult\n    Next i\n    \n    task.SetTaskResult \"status\", \"Completed\"\n    LongRunningTaskProc = 0\nEnd Function\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n",

  "textEditContent": "# ThreadPool Troubleshooting Guide\n\n## 1. Common Issues and Solutions\n\n### Tasks Not Starting\n#### Symptoms\n- Task not executing after creation\n- &#96;IsRunning&#96; returns False\n- No error messages\n\n#### Possible Causes\n1. Invalid task procedure address\n2. Resource limitations\n3. Thread creation failure\n\n#### Solutions\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\n' Check task procedure address\nPublic Function ValidateTaskProc(taskProc As LongPtr) As Boolean\n    If taskProc = 0 Then\n        Debug.Print \"Invalid task procedure address\"\n        ValidateTaskProc = False\n        Exit Function\n    End If\n    \n    ' Other validations...\n    ValidateTaskProc = True\nEnd Function\n\n' Resource check\nPublic Function CheckSystemResources() As Boolean\n    ' Check system resources\n    Dim availableMemory As Long\n    availableMemory = GetAvailableMemory()\n    \n    If availableMemory &lt; MINIMUM_REQUIRED_MEMORY Then\n        Debug.Print \"Insufficient system memory\"\n        CheckSystemResources = False\n        Exit Function\n    End If\n    \n    CheckSystemResources = True\nEnd Function\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Tasks Hanging\n#### Symptoms\n- Task remains in running state for extended time\n- No progress updates\n- Cannot be cancelled\n\n#### Diagnostic Steps\n1. Check task status\n2. Analyze task logs\n3. Check resource usage\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\nPublic Sub DiagnoseHungTask(task As cTask)\n    ' Collect diagnostic information\n    Debug.Print \"Task Status Diagnosis:\"\n    Debug.Print \"Runtime: \" &amp; task.ExecutionTime &amp; \"ms\"\n    Debug.Print \"Current status: \" &amp; task.GetTaskResult(\"status\")\n    Debug.Print \"Last progress update: \" &amp; task.GetTaskResult(\"lastProgressUpdate\")\n    Debug.Print \"Resource usage:\"\n    \n    ' Get detailed task information\n    Dim taskInfo As Dictionary\n    Set taskInfo = GetTaskDebugInfo(task)\n    \n    For Each key In taskInfo.Keys\n        Debug.Print key &amp; \": \" &amp; taskInfo(key)\n    Next\nEnd Sub\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Memory Leaks\n#### Symptoms\n- Memory usage continuously growing\n- Performance gradually degrading\n- Task execution slowing down\n\n#### Investigation Methods\n1. Monitor object references\n2. Track resource allocation\n3. Check circular references\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\n' Memory usage tracking\nPublic Sub TrackMemoryUsage(task As cTask)\n    Static lastCheck As Date\n    Static memoryReadings As Collection\n    \n    If memoryReadings Is Nothing Then\n        Set memoryReadings = New Collection\n    End If\n    \n    ' Record memory usage every minute\n    If DateDiff(\"s\", lastCheck, Now) &gt;= 60 Then\n        Dim usage As Dictionary\n        Set usage = New Dictionary\n        \n        usage.Add \"timestamp\", Now\n        usage.Add \"memoryUsage\", GetProcessMemoryUsage()\n        usage.Add \"taskObjects\", CountTaskObjects()\n        \n        memoryReadings.Add usage\n        lastCheck = Now\n        \n        ' Analyze memory trend\n        AnalyzeMemoryTrend memoryReadings\n    End If\nEnd Sub\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Deadlock Issues\n#### Symptoms\n- Multiple tasks waiting for each other\n- System response slowing down\n- Task execution stuck\n\n#### Solutions\n1. Implement deadlock detection\n2. Use lock timeouts\n3. Avoid nested locks\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\n' Deadlock detection\nPublic Sub DetectDeadlock(tasks As Collection)\n    Dim lockGraph As Dictionary\n    Set lockGraph = BuildLockGraph(tasks)\n    \n    If HasCycle(lockGraph) Then\n        ' Potential deadlock detected\n        LogDeadlockSituation lockGraph\n        \n        ' Attempt resolution\n        ResolveDeadlock tasks\n    End If\nEnd Sub\n\n' Lock acquisition with timeout\nPublic Function TryLockWithTimeout(ByVal timeoutMs As Long) As Boolean\n    Dim result As Long\n    result = WaitForSingleObject(m_StateLock, timeoutMs)\n    \n    Select Case result\n        Case WAIT_OBJECT_0\n            TryLockWithTimeout = True\n        Case WAIT_TIMEOUT\n            ' Record lock timeout\n            LogLockTimeout\n            TryLockWithTimeout = False\n        Case Else\n            ' Handle other errors\n            HandleLockError result\n            TryLockWithTimeout = False\n    End Select\nEnd Function\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 2. Performance Issue Diagnosis\n\n### Performance Monitoring\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\n' Performance monitoring wrapper\nPublic Function MonitorTaskPerformance(task As cTask) As Dictionary\n    Dim metrics As New Dictionary\n    \n    ' Collect basic metrics\n    metrics.Add \"executionTime\", task.ExecutionTime\n    metrics.Add \"cpuUsage\", GetTaskCPUUsage(task.ThreadID)\n    metrics.Add \"memoryUsage\", GetTaskMemoryUsage(task.ThreadID)\n    \n    ' Analyze performance bottlenecks\n    AnalyzePerformanceBottlenecks metrics\n    \n    Set MonitorTaskPerformance = metrics\nEnd Function\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Performance Optimization Recommendations\n1. Use performance profiling tools\n2. Optimize data structure usage\n3. Reduce lock contention\n4. Optimize resource usage\n\n## 3. Log Analysis\n\n### Log Levels\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\nPublic Enum LogLevel\n    LogLevel_Error = 1\n    LogLevel_Warning = 2\n    LogLevel_Info = 3\n    LogLevel_Debug = 4\nEnd Enum\n\n' Enhanced logging\nPublic Sub LogTaskEvent(task As cTask, level As LogLevel, message As String)\n    If level &lt;= GetCurrentLogLevel() Then\n        Dim logEntry As String\n        logEntry = BuildLogEntry(task, level, message)\n        WriteToLog logEntry\n        \n        ' For error level, additionally log diagnostic information\n        If level = LogLevel_Error Then\n            LogDiagnosticInfo task\n        End If\n    End If\nEnd Sub\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Log Analysis Tools\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\n' Log analyzer\nPublic Function AnalyzeTaskLogs(task As cTask) As Dictionary\n    Dim analysis As New Dictionary\n    \n    ' Get task logs\n    Dim logs As Object\n    Set logs = task.GetTaskResult(\"eventLog\")\n    \n    ' Analyze error patterns\n    analysis.Add \"errorPatterns\", AnalyzeErrorPatterns(logs)\n    \n    ' Analyze performance patterns\n    analysis.Add \"performanceMetrics\", AnalyzePerformanceMetrics(logs)\n    \n    ' Generate recommendations\n    analysis.Add \"recommendations\", GenerateRecommendations(analysis)\n    \n    Set AnalyzeTaskLogs = analysis\nEnd Function\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 4. Debug Techniques\n\n### Debug Helper Functions\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\n' Task status snapshot\nPublic Function CaptureTaskSnapshot(task As cTask) As Dictionary\n    Dim snapshot As New Dictionary\n    \n    ' Basic information\n    snapshot.Add \"threadId\", task.ThreadID\n    snapshot.Add \"status\", task.GetTaskResult(\"status\")\n    snapshot.Add \"runtime\", task.ExecutionTime\n    \n    ' Task data\n    Dim taskData As New Dictionary\n    For Each key In task.GetTaskDataKeys\n        taskData.Add key, task.GetTaskData(key)\n    Next\n    snapshot.Add \"taskData\", taskData\n    \n    ' Task results\n    Dim taskResults As New Dictionary\n    For Each key In task.GetTaskResultKeys\n        taskResults.Add key, task.GetTaskResult(key)\n    Next\n    snapshot.Add \"taskResults\", taskResults\n    \n    Set CaptureTaskSnapshot = snapshot\nEnd Function\n\n' Debug checkpoint\nPublic Sub DebugCheckpoint(task As cTask, checkpoint As String)\n    Static checkpoints As Dictionary\n    If checkpoints Is Nothing Then Set checkpoints = New Dictionary\n    \n    ' Record checkpoint time\n    If Not checkpoints.Exists(checkpoint) Then\n        checkpoints.Add checkpoint, Now\n    End If\n    \n    ' Analyze execution time\n    Dim timeSpent As Double\n    timeSpent = DateDiff(\"s\", checkpoints(checkpoint), Now)\n    \n    ' Log checkpoint information\n    LogTaskEvent task, LogLevel_Debug, _\n                \"Checkpoint: \" &amp; checkpoint &amp; _\n                \", Time spent: \" &amp; timeSpent &amp; \"s\"\nEnd Sub\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 5. Best Practices\n\n### Preventive Measures\n1. Implement health checks\n2. Set reasonable timeouts\n3. Use assertions for validation\n4. Implement graceful degradation\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\n' Task health check\nPublic Function CheckTaskHealth(task As cTask) As Boolean\n    ' Validate basic state\n    If Not ValidateTaskState(task) Then\n        LogTaskEvent task, LogLevel_Warning, \"Task state abnormal\"\n        Exit Function\n    End If\n    \n    ' Check resource usage\n    If Not CheckResourceUsage(task) Then\n        LogTaskEvent task, LogLevel_Warning, \"Resource usage abnormal\"\n        Exit Function\n    End If\n    \n    ' Validate data consistency\n    If Not ValidateTaskData(task) Then\n        LogTaskEvent task, LogLevel_Warning, \"Data consistency check failed\"\n        Exit Function\n    End If\n    \n    CheckTaskHealth = True\nEnd Function\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Emergency Handling\n1. Implement emergency stop mechanism\n2. Save critical data\n3. Log detailed information\n4. Notify relevant personnel\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\n' Emergency handling\nPublic Sub HandleEmergency(task As cTask, emergency As String)\n    ' Log emergency situation\n    LogTaskEvent task, LogLevel_Error, \"Emergency: \" &amp; emergency\n    \n    ' Save task state\n    SaveTaskState task\n    \n    ' Notify monitoring system\n    NotifyMonitoringSystem task, emergency\n    \n    ' Perform emergency cleanup\n    EmergencyCleanup task\nEnd Sub\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 6. Failure Recovery\n\n### Automatic Recovery Strategy\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\nPublic Sub AttemptTaskRecovery(task As cTask)\n    ' Analyze failure cause\n    Dim failureReason As String\n    failureReason = AnalyzeFailure(task)\n    \n    ' Select recovery strategy\n    Select Case failureReason\n        Case \"timeout\"\n            HandleTimeoutRecovery task\n        Case \"resource_exhaustion\"\n            HandleResourceRecovery task\n        Case \"deadlock\"\n            HandleDeadlockRecovery task\n        Case Else\n            HandleGenericRecovery task\n    End Select\nEnd Sub\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Data Recovery\n&#96;&#96;&#96;vb\n' Task state recovery\nPublic Function RestoreTaskState(task As cTask) As Boolean\n    ' Attempt recovery from backup\n    If RestoreFromBackup(task) Then\n        LogTaskEvent task, LogLevel_Info, \"Restored from backup\"\n        RestoreTaskState = True\n        Exit Function\n    End If\n    \n    ' Attempt to rebuild state\n    If RebuildTaskState(task) Then\n        LogTaskEvent task, LogLevel_Info, \"Task state rebuilt\"\n        RestoreTaskState = True\n        Exit Function\n    End If\n    \n    RestoreTaskState = False\nEnd Function\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n",
